context.note: Prices, volumes and fundamentals are real, cached once from Yahoo Finance and committed. Nothing is fetched at build time or in the browser, and none of this is investment advice.
context.factorNote: These are plain-language teaching buckets, not a licensed factor model or investment advice.
context.coMovementMethod: Weighted average of each holding’s 252-trading-day return correlation with the named representative basket.

factorDefinitions.MOMENTUM: A portfolio dominated by recent winners and their shared price behaviour.
factorDefinitions.VALUE: A portfolio dominated by banks, mature cash-generative companies and other cheaply priced cyclicals.
factorDefinitions.QUALITY: A portfolio dominated by durable, defensive businesses with comparatively steady price behaviour.
factorDefinitions.SIZE: A portfolio whose diversification is overwhelmed by the same mega-cap segment.
factorDefinitions.RATES: A portfolio dominated by banks, gold and other holdings whose common macro sensitivity is interest rates.
factorDefinitions.ENERGY: A portfolio dominated by producers and the broad energy-sector fund.
factorDefinitions.FX: A portfolio dominated by revenue earned outside the owner’s home economy or by a currency mismatch.
